ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Somali Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and potential money laundering involved in the Minnesota Somali fraud case.
questions: What are the sources of funding for the Somali fraud scheme?
How are the funds being laundered?
ideas.insight: This investigation could uncover a larger network of financial crimes and corruption. By following the money, we may be able to identify key players and disrupt the fraud scheme.

ideas.title: The Intersection of Politics and Fraud in Minnesota
